conventions.cartan_numbering: SageMath finite Cartan types (Bourbaki exceptional numbering)
conventions.coordinates: Each coordinate vector lists fundamental-weight coefficients omega_1,...,omega_rank.
conventions.springer_substitution: Normalized Springer coordinates Theta_i are replaced by omega_i before applying the Borel map.
conventions.schubert_index: Minimal right coset representative w in W/W_L; beta(omega_i)=epsilon_(s_i).

e6_normalization.effect: The printed Springer coordinates are three times the normalized coordinates. Retaining that scaling multiplies a degree-d image by 3^d.

psi_e7.scaling: Unscaled journal psi_d, not the divided arXiv inputs
